> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.3.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

People Atlas 0.3.0 expands the Markdown-first people and relationship workflow:

- Relationships are direction-free. `from` and `to` remain stable first/second
  serialization slots, while optional paired roles provide explicit endpoint
  meaning. A canonical **My person** setting can initialize perspective
  without changing relationship identity.
- Relationship rows now provide direct Open/Edit actions. Relationship
  templates use clearer copy-not-live behavior, and the person and
  relationship editors are organized into conceptual sections.
- Optional profile fields, vault-only photo selection, selected-person profile
  images, and bounded graph avatars add richer presentation without external
  asset loading.
- Contact moments are separate Markdown notes with explicit, unchecked,
  monotonic `last_contact` advancement. Selected-person history and the
  Follow-ups view expose due work through explicit Open/Edit/Done/Dismiss
  actions while preserving Bases filter privacy.

People Atlas 0.3.0 is intentionally fresh-vault-only: non-current plugin
settings schemas are rejected and canonical person, relationship, and
contact-moment notes require explicit IDs. Recreate the test vault or remove
the plugin data file instead of migrating older test data. Unowned note
frontmatter remains untouched. Follow-ups do not create operating-system
notifications or infer relationship status.

The verified uncompressed `main.js` ceiling is now 400 KiB; this release is
approximately 334 KiB after the compatibility cleanup.
